name: ielts-pte-platform
description: Production-ready IELTS & PTE test preparation and assessment platform (MERN monorepo)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w server && npm run lint:fix -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
